key.name: sleep-battery-timeout
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before suspending on battery power. 0 means never.

key.name: sleep-ac-timeout
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before suspending on AC power. 0 means never.

key.name: hibernate-delay
key.description: Seconds spent suspended before hibernating. 0 means never.

key.name: lid-action
key.description: What happens when the lid closes. system leaves the system setting unchanged.

key.name: keep-awake
key.description: Prevent idle sleep and screen blanking while enabled.

key.name: saved-sleep-battery-type
key.description: The system sleep-inactive-battery-type value saved before Sandman took over.

key.name: saved-sleep-ac-type
key.description: The system sleep-inactive-ac-type value saved before Sandman took over.

key.name: adopted
key.description: Whether Sandman has adopted the system power settings.
